# Purpose
This file defines a test executable that runs a set of sysvar unit tests. It includes separate test files for `test_sysvar_cache`, `test_sysvar_clock`, `test_sysvar_epoch_rewards`, `test_sysvar_epoch_schedule`, `test_sysvar_last_restart_slot`, `test_sysvar_recent_hashes`, `test_sysvar_rent`, `test_sysvar_slot_hashes`, `test_sysvar_slot_history`, and `test_sysvar_stake_history`, then calls each test from [`main`](<#main>). The file uses `fd_boot` and `fd_halt` for process setup and shutdown, and it reports success with `FD_LOG_NOTICE(( "pass" ))` after all tests complete.

The code also creates and manages a temporary workspace and shared memory region before running tests that need storage access. It allocates `wksp_mem`, creates a workspace with `fd_wksp_new`, joins it with `fd_wksp_join`, and attaches anonymous shared memory with `fd_shmem_join_anonymous`. After the tests finish, it releases the shared memory and workspace with `fd_shmem_leave_anonymous`, `fd_wksp_leave`, and `fd_wksp_delete`. This file does not define a public API; it is a test driver for sysvar-related components.
